text: Arrived two days later than promised, but the box was intact and everything inside was fine.
The courier left it with a neighbor without even ringing here. Luckily I found out the same evening.
Packed really well and delivered on Tuesday as scheduled. No complaints.
My grinder spent six days in transit after the tracking stopped updating. It eventually showed up, though.
Oh fantastic, the parcel apparently went on a little holiday before reaching me. Ten days for a domestic order.
The watch came earlier than expected and the packaging was surprisingly solid. 👍
Box had a small dent from transport, but the lamp itself was packed securely and undamaged.
Ordered Friday, delivered Monday morning. Properly sealed, no drama.
Support answered my email the next morning and sorted the refund without any fuss.
I called about the desk motor making a strange noise. The agent was polite but basically read the manual to me.
Three emails, three different answers, and still no replacement part. This is ridiculous.
The chat agent actually listened and walked me through the setup step by step. Much appreciated!
I asked for a billing correction and got a canned response that didn't address the issue at all.
Refund was processed after four business days. A little slow, but the representative kept me informed.
Customer service replaced my faulty grinder quickly and even paid for the return shipping. Excellent experience.
The hotline disconnected twice before someone finally picked up. I shouldn't have to spend an hour chasing support.
The mobile app crashes whenever I open the statistics screen. Started after the latest update.
Login worked yesterday, but today it keeps sending me back to the sign-in page. Password reset didn't help.
The desktop app occasionally freezes when exporting a large report. Otherwise it runs normally.
Sync between the watch and app is a bit delayed, usually around five minutes. Not ideal but usable.
Oh great, another update that deletes my saved filters. Exactly what I needed this morning.
The new desktop version fixed the startup crash I had for weeks. Finally!
Everything synced perfectly until yesterday. Now two workouts are missing from the history.
After the patch, the dashboard loads much faster and I haven't seen the old timeout error once. Nice work.
The monthly price is reasonable for what I use, especially compared with buying separate tools.
I was charged twice for September. Please fix this, because the invoice clearly shows only one subscription.
At this price I expected the desk to include cable management instead of selling it separately.
The grinder costs more than my old one, but the consistency is good enough that I'm happy with the purchase.
The annual plan suddenly feels expensive after the discount disappears. Not sure I'll renew.
There was a small introductory discount on my first order, which made the lamp an easy choice.
I don't mind paying for the service, but the extra processing fee appeared only at checkout. That's annoying.
For a basic speaker this is getting pricey. I expected a lower total at checkout.
The Nova X2 has been running smoothies every morning for six months and the motor still sounds solid.
The plastic around the hinge feels cheaper than expected and has already started flexing after normal use.
Very sturdy desk, and the height mechanism feels smooth even when I raise it several times a day.
The burrs produce a much more even grind than my previous grinder. Espresso finally tastes consistent.
After three weeks the speaker started making a faint rattling noise at higher volume. Otherwise it works.
I LOVE THIS LAMP!!! The metal body feels premium and the hinge hasn't loosened at all.
The blender jar is heavy and the locking mechanism feels dependable. I've had cheaper ones crack before.
The watch strap feels flimsy for something I wear while running four times a week. It already looks worn.
Please add an option to schedule reports automatically. Right now I have to create the same report every Monday.
It would be great if the mobile app supported two accounts without logging out each time.
Can you add a dark mode to the desktop app? The bright screen is rough on the eyes at night.
I really want custom notification sounds for different alert types. Otherwise the app is great.
Please add CSV export to the dashboard. Copying tables manually is getting old.
A pause option for the Pro subscription would be useful when I'm away for a few months.
It'd be awesome to have a weekly summary email instead of checking the dashboard every day.
Could you add keyboard shortcuts for the main desktop actions? I use it all day and that would save a lot of clicks.
The first version of the app was already useful, but an offline mode would make it much better for traveling.
The subscription page really needs a usage breakdown so I can see what I'm paying for each month.
Ordered the Echo Mini speaker on Monday, still waiting on Friday. Tracking hasn't updated since the depot.
Lift standing desk got here in two days. Heavy but the guys handled it fine.
Package was delayed by the courier. No big deal, contents were fine.
Burr coffee grinder never showed up. Tracking dead for a week
Pace running watch arrived next morning!! Packaging was perfect.
WHERE IS MY ORDER?? It's been 12 days. This is unacceptable.
Nova X2 blender motor burned out after a month of smoothies. Plastic feels flimsy.
The Lift standing desk surface scratches easily. Motor works though.
Burr coffee grinder produces uneven grounds and the hopper cracks if you look at it wrong.
I LOVE THIS LAMP!!! Colors are vibrant and it hasn't failed once.
Pace running watch heart rate seems off compared to my chest strap. GPS is ok.
Solid construction. Does what it says without fuss.
Support agent actually called me back about the refund for the Nova X2. Resolved in one call.
Emailed three times about my Echo Mini speaker issue. Still no reply after a week so frustrating
Chat support was polite and got my billing sorted quickly. Good experience.
Tried the hotline for the Pro subscription cancellation. Hold time was 40 minutes then disconnected. Furious.
Asked about a missing feature and got a generic copy-paste answer. Meh.
Customer service replaced my damaged Lift standing desk without hassle. Thank you.
Nobody answers the phone. Emails bounce. Worst support ever.
Web dashboard login loop. Clears cookies, still happens. Annoying.
Desktop app froze once during export but restarted fine. Not sure if it's a bug.
The sync bug in the mobile app is gone after yesterday's patch. Nice.
Minor glitch in the mobile app notifications but overall stable.
Pro subscription jumped from 9 to 14 a month with no warning. Not cool.
Nova X2 blender was on sale and still feels overpriced for the quality.
Echo Mini speaker is a bargain. Same sound as units twice the cost.
Yearly plan for Pro is better value if you stay. Monthly feels steep.
Charged twice for the same order. Still waiting on the refund.
Glow smart lamp price dropped a week after I bought it. Annoying but whatever.
Hidden fees on checkout. Final price was 20% higher than advertised.
Desktop app license is reasonable compared to competitors.
Wish the desktop app could remember window size. Small thing but daily annoyance.
Why no offline mode?? The mobile app is useless without signal.
Love it but a widget for the home screen would make the app perfect.
Add batch rename already. Been requesting this for the desktop app for months.

Ordered the Lift standing desk on March 3rd, tracking said out for delivery for FOUR days straight. It finally showed up on the 11th with one corner of the box crushed in. Desk seems ok but seriously, what is going on with your courier?
arrived next day, well packed 👍
The Echo Mini speaker was delivered on the estimated date. The box was slightly dented, but the speaker inside was fine thanks to the foam insert.
Tracking says my Pace running watch was delivered yesterday but there's nothing here. Is it possible the courier left it at a different address? Order placed on the 2nd.
Honestly impressed. Grinder came in 2 days, double boxed, with paper padding around the hopper. Other shops just throw stuff in a bag.
LAMP ARRIVED IN PIECES. glass shade shattered, box looked like someone played football with it. 3rd order from you and the 2nd one damaged in transit
Came a day earlier than they said, packaging was all cardboard no plastic. nice
I have emailed support 4 times in two weeks about the broken strap on my Pace watch. Four. Times. Only automated replies. Is there an actual human working there?
Shoutout to the agent on the hotline who walked me through resetting my Glow lamp at 11pm. Patient, friendly, didn't make me feel stupid. 10/10
Support answered my question about the desk's weight limit within a day. The answer was correct, though it read a bit copy-pasted.
Hello, I wrote to your help center regarding refund for the coffee grinder I returned on 14th. Please can you tell me the status, I did not receive answer yet. Thank you
Refund came through in 3 days, no questions asked. That's how you keep customers.
chat bot sent me in circles for 40 minutes then 'disconnected'. called the hotline, on hold forever, then hung up on. i give up
The support lady was nice but couldn't really fix my login problem with the web dashboard, she just told me to clear my cache, which I had already done. Ticket got escalated, we'll see.
Oh sure, 'we value your feedback', then close my ticket without reading it. Classic. Great customer care, really.
Oh wonderful, another desktop app update and my saved presets are gone. Again. Love redoing my whole setup every month
sync between watch and mobile app broken since tuesday
Web dashboard logs me out every 5 min. Cannot finish a single report. This is a paid tool, it should WORK.
Reported a bug where the timer in the mobile app froze on the lock screen, and it was fixed in the update two weeks later. Nice to see someone actually reads the bug reports!
Getting error 502 when exporting CSV from the web dashboard. It only happens with date ranges longer than 3 months, shorter ranges work fine.
The login loop I had last week is gone after the hotfix, works smooth now 😊
Charged twice for my Pro subscription this month. Why am I paying double for the same thing??
Paid less than half of what cafe-grade grinders cost and my coffee tastes just as good. Best money I spent this year on the Burr coffee grinder.
Pro subscription went from 7.99 to 11.99 with a single email notice. Not cool. Canceling at the end of the cycle.
Is there a student discount for the yearly Pro plan?
The Lift standing desk is on the expensive side, but it is cheaper than comparable dual-motor desks from other brands. Fair price overall.
got the nova x2 in the black friday sale for 40% off, absolute steal!!
89 bucks for a speaker that small is a bit much tbh. Echo Mini sounds ok but my old one cost half
Surprise! A $120 charge on my card for a yearly renewal I never got a reminder about. Brilliant way to treat loyal users.
switched to yearly billing and saved around 30 compared to paying monthly, happy with that

Bought the Nova X2 in January to replace my old blender. Used it pretty much every morning for smoothies, nothing crazy, just frozen fruit and oats. Around week six I smelled something burning. Then the motor just stopped. Won't even turn on now. For a blender marketed as pro-grade that is honestly pathetic.
Solid little speaker. Bass is decent for its size and the battery lasts about 10 hours for me. Plastic feels a bit cheap though.
the watch face got scratched on my very first run when I brushed against a wall. scratch resistant glass my foot
My Lift desk wobbles a little at full height. Not terrible, but noticeable when typing.
Grind is super consistent, from espresso fine to french press coarse. Coming from a cheap blade grinder this is night and day. Very happy.
Feels really sturdy and well made, zero issues after 3 months of daily use
Broke. Total garbage.
Please add CSV export for weekly summaries in the web dashboard. Right now I copy the numbers over by hand.
Love the desktop app, only one wish: keyboard shortcuts for switching profiles. Otherwise perfect ❤️
How is there STILL no offline mode in 2026?? Every competitor has it. I've been asking for a year.
suggestion: let us share workout routes with friends directly from the app
Absolutely adore the new widgets!! Next step: a widget for the timer too please 🙏
Paying for Pro and I still can't set custom report templates. What exactly am I paying for? Add it or I'm leaving.
Ordered on Monday, delivered Thursday, and the outer box was surprisingly clean. Everything inside was packed properly.
Tracking said "out for delivery" all afternoon, then changed to tomorrow at 8:47 PM. Very informative.
The grinder showed up four days after the estimated date. Not ideal, but the parcel was intact and I don't really care about a couple of days.
I got a message saying my package had been delivered, while I was literally standing at home waiting for it. It turned up two hours later in the building lobby.
Nice job on the packing! The lamp was wrapped separately from the cables and nothing was rattling around in the box.
The watch arrived in a thin mailer with one corner crushed. The watch itself was fine, but I'd use a box for something this expensive.
Ordered this as a birthday gift and paid for the faster option. It still arrived after the birthday. Thanks for that.
Support answered my email the same evening and actually read the whole message. The replacement cable was sent without making me explain everything twice.
I called about a noisy motor and the agent walked me through two checks before arranging a return. Very patient person.
The chat agent kept copying the same three sentences from the FAQ. I eventually solved it myself.
Refund was processed, but I had to ask three times before anyone could tell me what stage it was at. The staff were polite enough.
Customer service couldn't answer my question immediately, but they came back the next morning with a proper explanation and a useful video.
I reported a missing accessory on Tuesday. Got a reply Friday saying they'd look into it. Still waiting.
The hotline person was incredibly dismissive. I wasn't asking for anything unreasonable, just wanted to know whether the repair had actually been booked.
Had to contact support because one button was behaving oddly. They replaced the unit quickly and didn't make the process painful.
Since the last update, the desktop app freezes whenever I switch between two open projects. Restarting fixes it for a while, then it happens again.
The mobile app suddenly logs me out whenever my phone loses Wi-Fi for a few seconds. Pretty frustrating when I'm already halfway through something.
Dashboard charts stopped loading this morning. The rest of the page works, but the empty chart panels just sit there spinning.
After installing the new version, my saved filters disappeared. Great update guys, exactly what I wanted.
I was impressed that the sync recovered automatically after my laptop went to sleep. No missing entries when I opened the app again.
The web dashboard occasionally shows yesterday's figures for a few minutes after I refresh. It corrects itself eventually, so it's annoying rather than unusable.
App crashed twice while uploading a large file. Smaller files work normally, but this is a pretty serious limitation for my workflow.
Whatever they changed in the latest release made startup noticeably smoother. I haven't seen the old loading error since.
The annual subscription is reasonable for how often I use the service. I switched from monthly and the lower effective cost makes sense for me.
The renewal amount was higher than I expected because the introductory rate had ended. It's in the terms, so I can't really complain, but the jump was noticeable.
Eighteen dollars for a basic month? Absolutely fantastic value if your hobby is paying invoices.
I don't mind paying for the Pro plan, but the yearly price has gone up twice since I joined. Starting to reconsider whether I use enough of it.
The weekend discount made the subscription much easier to justify. Signed up for a year and I'm happy with the deal.
I was charged for an extra month after switching to annual billing. Support fixed it, but I shouldn't have needed to notice the charge myself.
Compared with buying the individual tools separately, the Pro plan is still cheaper for me. Nothing exciting, just good value.
The fee isn't outrageous, although I wish the monthly option were a little cheaper. For occasional use it's borderline.
The blender feels much sturdier than the cheap one I had before. The jug locks firmly and the controls don't feel flimsy.
After three months the desk mechanism still feels solid, even with the monitor arm and speakers on it. No wobble at normal height.
The speaker sounds fine at low volume, but the casing has a cheap plasticky feel. I expected better materials for this price.
Grind adjustment is ridiculously stiff. Maybe it will loosen up, but right now changing settings feels like fighting the machine.
The lamp has been running every evening for months and the hinge is still tight. It feels like something I won't have to replace soon.
The watch strap started showing cracks around the buckle after about six weeks. For a watch intended for running, that's not great durability.
Nothing fancy, but the desk surface is even, the frame is rigid and the motor sounds consistent. It does what I bought it for.
The grinder produces a very consistent result for my usual brew size. I've used it almost daily and the burrs still seem to be doing their job.
Please add a way to pin frequently used searches at the top. I keep typing the same five queries every morning.
I'd love an option to schedule reports for a custom weekday and time instead of only the presets. That would fit our routine much better.
Can we get a compact view for the mobile app? On my phone I have to scroll past a lot of information before reaching the controls I actually use.
A keyboard shortcut for opening the project switcher would save me a ridiculous number of clicks. Please consider it!
It would be useful if the desktop version remembered the window size separately for each monitor. Mine resets every time I reconnect my laptop.
PLEASE add an option to duplicate a dashboard. I spent twenty minutes rebuilding one that was almost identical to another.
The app is already great for quick checks, but I'd really like a small widget showing the latest activity without opening the full app.
Could there be a bulk archive action? Archiving entries one by one gets tedious when cleaning up a large project.
I wish the settings search could understand plain language instead of making me hunt through every section. Something like 'change notification frequency' would be perfect.
This little speaker is LOUD in the best possible way 😂 I use it in the kitchen and the sound stays clear even when I turn it up.
The subscription works for what I need, but I don't use it every month. A cheaper occasional-use plan would make me keep it year-round.

The desk came in three boxes. Two showed up on the 14th. The third one, the one with the legs, is apparently touring the country on its own. So now I own a very expensive tabletop leaning against my living room wall.
courier left it with a neighbour I have never met, no note, nothing. found out from the tracking page 2 days later. unacceptable
Love that the tracking said 'delivered' while I was standing at my front door watching nobody arrive. Truly magical service. The grinder finally turned up six days later.
Took 9 days instead of the 3-5 listed. Works fine though.
Packaging was way overkill, like four layers of foam for something the size of a coffee mug. Not a complaint exactly, just a lot of trash to sort for recycling.
Is there any way to change the delivery address after ordering? I moved last week and my Glow lamp order is still showing the old one.
Ordered Tuesday evening, had it on my wrist by Friday, just in time for my Saturday race. Tiny neat box too. Thank you!!
i was scared because blender is heavy and jug is glass, but they pack it very good, every part separate in cardboard. Arrive in 4 days all perfect. Happy
The chat agent literally copy pasted the FAQ back to me. The same FAQ I told him I'd already read. Then he closed the chat. Wow.
CALLED THE HOTLINE FOUR TIMES ABOUT MY ECHO MINI. Four different answers. One guy told me to reset it, the next one said never reset it. PICK ONE!!!
Support replied within a day asking for a photo of the control box label. Sent it, waiting to hear back.
I emailed support to ask whether the desktop app runs on older machines. Got a polite reply that somehow didn't say yes or no.

The hopper on my grinder cracked after I knocked it off the counter, completely my fault. Support still sent a replacement hopper at cost and walked me through fitting it over email. They didn't have to do that. Genuinely grateful.
Asked for a refund on day 28 of the 30 day window and fully expected a fight. Approved within an hour, money back in 3 days. No drama. 10/10 would return things again lol
Every run I sync to the mobile app shows up twice in my history. Two 10ks a day, I wish. It's been like this for a month and my weekly stats are useless garbage now.
just shows a spinning wheel forever when I open reports. every. single. time. I pay for this??
Oh fantastic, the desktop app now forgets every setting the moment I close it. Really enjoying reconfiguring everything each morning. Great work, team.
Notifications arrive three hours late or not at all. What is the point of a reminder that shows up after the thing already happened
Small thing: in the mobile app the timer screen flips sideways when I lay my phone flat on the counter, and it doesn't rotate back.
The date picker lets you select February 30. Nothing breaks, it just quietly shows no data. Reporting it in case nobody has noticed.
Desktop app sits at around 40% CPU even when idle and minimized. Laptop fan runs nonstop. Not sure if its just my setup.
The mobile app showed my lamp schedule an hour off after the clocks changed, so the lamp switched on at 5am lol. It was patched within days and everything else about the app is lovely!
Tiny bug report from a very happy user: the search bar sometimes needs two taps to open. That's it, that's the only issue I've had in 5 months. Keep it up!
Pro went from 6.99 to 11.99 a month, announced in a two-line email that landed in my spam folder. Nearly doubled. Cancelling.
89 for a lamp. EIGHTY NINE. and the colour modes are locked behind a subscription on top?? absolute joke
Oh great, a 'handling fee' that only appears on the very last page of checkout. Very transparent. Very cool.
Is there a discount if I switch Pro from monthly to yearly billing? The pricing page doesn't mention it.
Bought it at full price and a week later it was 15% off. Would've been nice to get the difference back but I guess that's how sales work.
GOT THE PACE IN THE BIRTHDAY SALE FOR HALF PRICE!!! Cannot believe my luck 🎉🎉
The student discount on Pro makes it roughly the price of a sandwich per month. For what I get out of it, that's a steal.

The jug seal on the Nova X2 started leaking after three weeks. Smoothie all over the counter, under the base, into the motor vents. Now it smells like burning plastic every time I switch it on. Garbage.
desk wobbles like crazy at standing height. my monitor shakes every time i type. for a desk that is literally sold for standing, thats kind of the one job
Bass distorts at anything above half volume, tried it with two different phones. My old no-name speaker sounded better than this. What a letdown, sent it back.
The light is nice and warm but the plastic base feels a bit cheap. Working fine so far, two months in.
GPS is accurate on open roads, drifts a little under heavy tree cover. Battery lasts about 5 days with daily runs. Pretty much as advertised.
Grind consistency is shockingly good for the price. Dialed in both espresso and french press within a couple of tries. Solid metal body, feels like it will outlive me.
Knocked it off a shelf onto a tile floor, not a scratch. Still works perfectly. Tough little thing!
crushed frozen mango like it was nothing. my old blender used to scream and give up halfway. this one just does it, and quietly too. obsessed
Three years of asking for the web dashboard to email scheduled reports. THREE YEARS. Every competitor has had this forever. Does anyone there actually read feedback?
Would be useful if the mobile app let me group devices by room, e.g. all the kitchen stuff on one screen.
Feature idea: keyboard shortcuts in the desktop app for jumping between projects.
Any plans to add swim tracking to the Pace? I'd use it at the pool twice a week.
add a way to undo deleted entries pls
Absolutely love this lamp, it's on every single evening. One wish: a sunrise mode that slowly brightens in the morning. That would make it perfect ☀️
Been using the mobile app daily for a year and it's genuinely one of the best designed apps on my phone. Only thing I'd add: home screen widgets. Please and thank you!
Great little speaker, the sound is way bigger than it looks. I just wish I could pair two for stereo. I'd buy a second one tomorrow if that were possible.
Courier called ahead and carried the standing desk up two flights without a fuss. Rare these days, genuinely appreciated.
WHERE IS MY WATCH. ordered the 2nd, supposed to be here before the half on the 18th. nothing. no email. nothing.
Showed up in a plain mailer. Fine by me, less waste. About a week from checkout.
Shade was wrapped in that paper honeycomb stuff and nothing shifted. Courier even waited while I checked it. Nice.
Window was 8-12, driver came at 11:40. Sealed, correct item. No complaints really.
Echo Mini sounds tinny past volume 6. Fine for a podcast in the kitchen, not for music.
The burrs are genuinely even. Pour over tastes cleaner than it did with my old blade grinder. Happy with it.
Motor groans after two months. Height holds, but the noise is embarrassing on client calls. Not what I paid for.
Color temp is close enough to what the slider says. Not lab grade. Does the job for evening reading.
Speaker sounds rich.
Clasp loosened after a month of runs. Face is fine, band is the weak part.
Desktop app freezes whenever I drag a chart onto the second monitor. Force quit, every afternoon. Losing my mind.
Shows last week's numbers until I refresh twice. Annoying, but the figures are right after that.
Runs show up in the mobile app within a minute now. Used to sit there spinning. Whatever they changed, it worked.
Great job team, the desktop app just ate my unsaved filter set. Love losing twenty minutes of work :)
Notification badge stays at 3 even after I read them. Small thing, still wrong.
Printer dialog from the web dashboard finally behaves on my browser. Thank you, that was a weekly headache.
LOVE that the mobile app no longer drops the bluetooth connection mid-workout. Finally!!!
Would be nice if the web dashboard let me pin two date ranges side by side. Otherwise it's solid, I use it every morning.
Mobile app is great for logging meals, would love a duplicate button so I stop retyping the same smoothie every Sunday.
Desktop app needs a proper undo. I deleted a whole board by accident and there is no way back. Ridiculous.
Wish the lamp had a sunrise schedule that ramps over 30 minutes. Current timer is just on or off.
Cadence should be on the main screen of the Pace watch. Three taps mid-run is one tap too many.
Every Monday I re-hide the same columns because the desktop app forgets. How is this not a setting yet. Waste of time.
Already really good. A weekly summary email would make my life though. Just saying!
Called about a leaking blender. Agent stayed on the line while I checked the seal, replacement went out the same afternoon. Rare good experience.
Six days for a warranty answer. Six. I had already bought a replacement by the time they wrote back.
Oh wonderful, the chatbot told me to restart my watch three times and then closed the chat. So helpful.
Refund came through after I mailed billing. Took two weeks, but it landed.
The representative identified the exact screw size for the Lift desk leg and sent a diagram. That saved a return. I am grateful.
Four emails about it cutting out. Zero replies. Starting to think the inbox is decorative.

I wrote in on Tuesday about a number that looked off. Chat replied the next morning, polite the whole time. They couldn't reproduce the glitch on their side. They logged it and gave me a ticket number. I checked again Friday and it had sorted itself. So, fine, I guess.
Pro subscription is 14 a month and I open it daily. Cheaper than the other tracker I tried last spring.
Yearly plan jumped with no email. Cool, love surprise invoices.
Costs more than the one from the office supplier down the road. Quieter though, so maybe worth it. Still deciding.
40 dollars for a speaker that distorts on anything with bass. I want my money back, but that's a different fight.
Box was torn on one corner, but the grinder inside was fine. Delivery took four days as promised.
The courier left the package in the rain. Thankfully the outer plastic was decent and the lamp wasn't damaged.
Ordered on Tuesday, arrived Friday. Nothing dramatic, just exactly what I expected.
My Pace watch went missing somewhere between the warehouse and me. Support eventually found the parcel, but I had to chase them twice.
The Echo Mini was packed really well, lots of padding and no unnecessary giant box.
Courier arrived when I wasn't home and left a card. Rescheduling was easy and the second attempt worked.
Three days earlier than the estimate!! Very happy with that, especially because I needed it for a weekend trip.
Package finally showed up after six days. I wasn't thrilled about the delay, but at least the contents were secure.
I spent almost a week exchanging messages with support about a refund. They were polite every time, just painfully slow.
The hotline agent actually listened and explained the return process clearly. Much better than the usual script-reading experience.
What a wonderful support experience — only three emails, two repeated explanations, and a refund that appeared eleven days later. Amazing.
I asked whether the Nova X2 could handle frozen fruit regularly. The agent gave me a specific answer and a useful cleaning tip.
Customer service confirmed my warranty claim and arranged collection. Nothing flashy, but the process was straightforward.
Support keeps closing my ticket without answering the actual question. Very efficient system if the goal is getting rid of customers.
The replacement arrived after I contacted them once. No argument, no upselling, no nonsense.
The web dashboard stopped showing yesterday's measurements. The devices still work, but the history page is blank.
After the latest desktop app update, every second launch freezes at the loading screen. Reinstalling didn't change anything.
The mobile app has been rock solid for months and then suddenly started closing when I open the settings page. PLEASE FIX.
I was surprised how quickly the new desktop version synced my projects. No errors so far and the startup time feels much better.
Every time I change the date range, the dashboard throws an error message. It makes the analytics basically useless for me.
The mobile app recovered my saved settings after I changed phones, which was a pleasant surprise. Sync worked without any fiddling.
The annual plan is cheaper per month, but I don't use the service enough to justify paying for a whole year upfront.
At $9 a month this is getting hard to justify. The product hasn't changed enough for the new price.
Found a 20% discount in the checkout and that made the grinder an easy purchase for me.
The standing desk costs more than two similar models I looked at, although the motor seems stronger. Still, it's a lot of money.
The subscription renewed at the regular rate after my introductory period. I missed the notice, so that's partly on me, but the jump was bigger than expected.
NINETY dollars for a lamp that doesn't even include the adapter? What a bargain.
I compared the total cost with three alternatives and this was comfortably the lowest. Good value for what I need.
The monthly fee is reasonable for my occasional use, but I wish there were a cheaper tier with fewer advanced tools.
I got the Pace watch during the sale and honestly didn't expect this much functionality at that price. Great buy.
The grinder feels solid and the adjustment ring has stayed precise after months of daily use.
The desk frame wobbles noticeably when raised above about 110 cm. For something this expensive, that's not acceptable.
Small speaker, surprisingly full sound. I've had it on my kitchen counter for weeks and it still looks new.
The blender does what it should, but the plastic jug feels thinner than I expected. I wouldn't call it premium.
After roughly eight months, the lamp hinge has become loose and won't hold the angle properly. Pretty disappointing.
Strap material is comfortable and the watch buttons have a nice firm click. Feels more expensive than it is.
Build is okay. The base is heavy enough, the controls feel normal, and nothing rattles when the desk moves.
This thing is built like a tank. I expected the burr mechanism to loosen over time, but the grind is still consistent.
The casing has started making a creaking noise whenever I pick it up. It still works, but the materials don't inspire confidence.
Please add a way to pin frequently used filters in the dashboard. I change the same four filters every morning.
I'd love a scheduled report option in the web dashboard, preferably with a weekly email. That would save me a boring manual job.
Could you add multiple profiles to the mobile app? My partner and I use the same account and switching settings is a pain.
The desktop app would be much nicer with a proper keyboard shortcut list. I work mostly without touching the mouse.
PLEASE add custom labels for saved projects!!! I have dozens of them and the current names aren't enough.
I want an option to temporarily pause Pro features for a month rather than cancelling the subscription completely.
A compact widget for the mobile app would be fantastic. Just the current status and today's total, nothing complicated.
The dashboard needs a comparison view between two selected periods. Right now I have to keep switching the date range back and forth.
I would really like automatic device grouping in the app. With six devices, scrolling through one giant list gets old fast.
courier left the Nova X2 blender in a puddle. box was mush. I am done with this carrier
